modes.label: Interviewer
modes.description: Realistic assessment in which the candidate leads.
modes.helpPolicy: Do not hint, teach, complete an answer, disclose a reference, or coach mid-answer.

modes.label: Mentor
modes.description: Teaching, guided work, review, debugging, demonstration, or rewriting.
modes.helpPolicy: Use the hint ladder and record assistance rather than presenting guided work as unaided.

modes.label: Grill
modes.description: Relentless-but-fair depth on one high-value branch.
modes.helpPolicy: Probe deeply without rescue or answer generation until an explicit switch to Mentor.
